svg.title: Cut along the structure
svg.text: Four rules. They work on Markdown, HTML and PDF alike.
## starts a section · text before it becomes “Overview”
paragraphs, list items, whole tables · never cut mid-row
80 words here · too long? split between units
Title > Section · stable ID · groups · hashes
TABLE TOO LONG? SPLIT BETWEEN ROWS,
Travel Policy > Daily limits by city
City | Hotel per night | Meals per day
Travel Policy > Daily limits by city
City | Hotel per night | Meals per day
Parts 1–2: the paragraph above the table, split between sentences.
